The report should read like an article that might appear in a newspaper or academic journal. As such, we don't want to see any code! Include `#| echo: false` at the top of your code chunks so that only the *output* of the code appears:

```{r}
#| echo: false

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
```

We don't want to see any code, nor do we want to see any raw R output. So, if you want to report summaries or regression results, make sure they appear in a cute lil' table, like this:


```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(
    Mean = mean(flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```
